title: South Korea Voices Regret Over Ukraine's Denial of North Korean POW Pact
detail: South Korea expressed regret after Ukraine denied a reported agreement on the repatriation or handling of North Korean prisoners of war captured during the Russia-Ukraine war. The denial came following a Yonhap News Agency report claiming a deal had been reached. The episode highlights the diplomatic complexity surrounding North Korean troops deployed to fight alongside Russian forces in Ukraine.

media.caption: South Korea expresses regret over Ukraine's denial of North Korean POW pact
